unit.why: A son's report, from the preface to זכרון דברים, of his father's prodigious learning at age seven and his method of study. It is a description of traits and habits, not a narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series of praises of the same figure, continuing from (ב) into (ד). The closing words 'ממדריגותיו הנוראים' appear to head the next item.
